title: Four disciplines.
*One ownership story.*
lede: Engage us for one discipline or all four. Each is scoped up front, with clear deliverables and the right licensed professionals alongside.

items.title: Equity Structuring
items.short: Frameworks for how ownership should work
items.text: Custom equity frameworks designed around your industry and ownership. Whether it’s an early dilutive investment or a late-stage leveraged buyout structure, we align your equity distribution strategy with institutional standards.
includes: Share classes and instruments: equity, CCPS, CCDs
ESOP pool sizing and vesting design
items.bestFor: Founders before a round · promoters restructuring
items.outcome: A recommended equity structure your board can approve

items.title: Capital Facilitation
items.text: We facilitate the equity transformation required to mobilise working capital: preparing the company, coordinating valuation and investors, and creating transparent liquidity pathways for every stakeholder.
includes: Valuations by registered valuers and FEMA pricing certificates
items.bestFor: Companies raising growth or working capital
items.outcome: A round that closes with a clean, agreed cap table

items.title: Ownership Management
items.short: One accurate record of who owns what
items.text: A single, reconciled source of truth for your ownership: shareholder records, ESOP administration, funding-round history and clear ownership visualisation for founders, investors and employees.
includes: Reconciled cap table and shareholder register
ESOP grants, vesting and exercise administration
Share dematerialisation under Rule 9B, where applicable
items.bestFor: Growing companies with investors or an ESOP
items.outcome: Ownership that is accurate before anyone asks

items.title: Transaction Support
items.text: Equity specialists who assist at every stage. We coordinate your CA, CS and legal counsel so documentation, approvals and filings stay aligned with local regulation, and the cap table is updated the day the deal closes.
includes: SHA / SSA coordination with legal counsel
Allotment filings (PAS-3, MGT-14) with your CS
items.outcome: A documented, compliant close with no loose ends
